name: Imperial Archers
headerMeta: Heroic era · Ranged Infantry · special · 235 leadership · T4 Mastery · C-tier
pitch: A standard archer with high theoretical damage output that struggles to convert into value in the modern meta. Leadership shifts and fast-paced engagements make traditional ranged obsolete; you're better served by a frontline or cavalry unit.

doctrines.name: Bowmanship Doctrine V
doctrines.effect: Arrow Rain deals 75% of the unit's base piercing DMG per hit, +150 piercing DMG.
doctrines.note: Arrow Rain deals 75% of unit's base piercing per hit, +150 piercing DMG

doctrines.name: Precision Doctrine V
doctrines.effect: +120 piercing DMG, +80 piercing AP, +9% rate of fire.
doctrines.note: +120 piercing DMG, +80 piercing AP, +9% rate of fire

doctrines.name: LDS Doctrine
doctrines.note: alt for piercing DMG if needed

doctrines.name: Whistling Arrow Doctrine V
doctrines.effect: Every 3 hits inflicts bleeding for 12% of target's current HP; can trigger in concert with allied units at weak points.
doctrines.note: alt for piercing, bleed on low-count / high-armor targets

doctrines.name: Artemis
doctrines.effect: Unlocks Double Strings: fires 2 arrows per shot for 12s, 40s CD; can't combine with other actives except Overwatch.
doctrines.note: alt for piercing, double shoot, exploits same low-count / high-armor angle

veterancy.label: Damage line
veterancy.body: Standard archers fall in the single-viable-line category — boost in DMG. Applicable identically to all four units in the thread (Vassal Longbowmen, Imperial Archers, Vanguard Archer, Ironcap Archer).

battleRole.tips: Some archers with Arrow Rain in veterancy cannot equip Arrow Rain doctrine — if that applies here, equip more piercing instead. {1}
